# Lucretia My Reflection

Journal: `ep1/quests/main_quest/q302_reed` · `MainQuest` · hash `2021481073`.

Journal premise: Ahhh, back to the land of the livin'… Shame Songbird was the price to pay. Think she really kicked the bucket? My gut tells me this fiasco's nothin' but a small setback, although my nose did catch the unmistakable whiff of a 'runner's deep-fried gray matter... Now all that's left is surviving NC's most twisted district while babysittin' Madam Prez herself... Shit, V, take on a simpler gig next time, would ya?
